If theclaw proposes/creates something Jonny didn’t ask for → requires Jonny approval first.

Approvals happen in Telegram (e.g. ‘Approved ✅ #ID’).

cards.title: Define business idea constraints (Jonny)
cards.description:
Outcome: 5–10 bullets that define what kind of business to pursue.

Prompt:
- Audience you want to serve?
- B2B vs B2C?
- Price point target?
- Time per week available?
- Do you want to use AI/automation heavily?
- Do you want to build in public?
- Any absolute no-gos?
